summary: SI-BONE filed an 8-K reporting a routine lease amendment and a product recall, not a special situation. On September 11, 2026, the company amended its Santa Clara headquarters lease with BIXBY SPE FINANCE 11, LLC, extending the 21,848-square-foot term by one month to October 31, 2026, at $43,696 monthly base rent, with the company continuing to pay its share of operating expenses and taxes. Separately, on August 21, 2026, SI-BONE initiated a voluntary recall of 98 iFuse TORQ implants over sterile-barrier packaging failures; two had been implanted. No arbitrage angle; monitor recall costs and regulatory follow-up.
